name: Seled
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Seled was a descendant of Judah through the Jerahmeel clan. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles in a genealogy, where it is stated that he died without children. Apart from this genealogical record, we have no further information about his life or deeds.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Seled is listed as the son of Nadab, a descendant of Jerahmeel in the tribe of Judah. It is noted that he died without children.

keyEvents.title: The Lineage of Jerahmeel
keyEvents.description: Seled belongs to the lineage of Jerahmeel, which is part of the broader genealogy of the tribe of Judah in the Books of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: The Sons of Nadab
keyEvents.description: Seled and Appaim are mentioned as the two sons of Nadab. While Seled died childless, Appaim continued the family line through his son Ishi.

keyEvents.title: The Family as Part of Israel's History
keyEvents.description: The genealogies in Chronicles were recorded to preserve Israel's tribal history, especially after the exile, and Seled is part of this important historical documentation.
